00090 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)                            \
00091         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                                            \
00092         float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                                              \
00093         float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);                 \
00094         float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);               \
00095                                                                                                                         \
00096             while(numSamplesToProcess--)                                                                                \
00097             {                                                                                                           \
00098                 BinaryOpSymbolUGenLoopBody(outputSamples, =,                                                            \
00099                     leftOperandSamples, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL, rightOperandSamples);                                        \
00100             }                                                                                                           \

00102 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)                          \
00103         const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                                                        \
00104         unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                                                             \
00105         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                                            \
00106         float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                                              \
00107         float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);                 \
00108         float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);               \
00109                                                                                                                         \
00110         int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                                                                 \
00111                                                                                                                         \
00112             while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                                                            \
00113                 float nextValue = value;                                                                                \
00114                 if(numKrSamples == 0)                                                                                   \
00115                     nextValue = *leftOperandSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightOperandSamples;                             \
00116                                                                                                                         \
00117                 numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                                              \
00118                                                                                                                         \
00119                 blockPosition       += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00120                 leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00121                 rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00122                                                                                                                         \
00123                 if(nextValue == value) {                                                                                \
00124                     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                                        \
00125                         *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                                                                   \
00126                         --numSamplesToProcess;                                                                          \
00127                         --numKrSamples;                                                                                 \
00128                     }                                                                                                   \
00129                 } else {                                                                                                \
00130                     float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();                             \
00131                     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                                        \
00132                         *outputSamples++ = value;                                                                       \
00133                         value += valueSlope;                                                                            \
00134                         --numSamplesToProcess;                                                                          \
00135                         --numKrSamples;                                                                                 \
00136                     }                                                                                                   \
00137                     value = nextValue;                                                                                  \
00138                 }                                                                                                       \
00139             }                                                                                                           \

00156         const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                                                        \
00157         unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                                                             \
00158         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                                            \

00162                                                                                                                         \
00163         int numKrSamples = blockPosition & krBlockSize;                                                                 \

00165             while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                                                            \

00169                                                                                                                         \
00170                 numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                                              \

00172                 blockPosition       += numKrSamples;                                                                    \

00174                 rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00175                                                                                                                         \
00176                 if(nextValue == value) {                                                                                \
00177                     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                                        \

00179                         --numSamplesToProcess;                                                                          \
00180                         --numKrSamples;                                                                                 \
00181                     }                                                                                                   \
00182                 } else {                                                                                                \
00183                     float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();                             \
00184                     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                                        \

00395     UGenArray UGenArray::operator OPSYMBOL (UGenArray const& rightOperand) const throw()                                \
00396     {                                                                                                                   \
00397         int size;                                                                                                       \
00398                                                                                                                         \
00399         if(internal->size_ > rightOperand.internal->size_)  size = internal->size_;                                     \
00400         else                                                size = rightOperand.internal->size_;                        \
00401                                                                                                                         \
00402         UGenArray newArray(size);                                                                                       \
00403                                                                                                                         \
00404         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++) {                                                                                 \
00405             newArray.internal->array[i] = wrapAt(i) OPSYMBOL rightOperand.wrapAt(i);                                    \
00406         }                                                                                                               \
00407                                                                                                                         \
00408         return newArray;                                                                                                \
00409     }                                                                                                                   \
00410                                                                                                                         \
00411     Buffer Buffer::operator OPSYMBOL (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw()                                         \
00412     {                                                                                                                   \
00413         const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; \
00414         const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                                    \
00415         const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                                    \
00416         const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                                                           \
00417                                                                                                                         \
00418         Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                                                   \
00419                                                                                                                         \
00420         for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                                        \
00421         {                                                                                                               \
00422             int numSamples;                                                                                             \
00423             float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                                           \
00424             float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;                \
00425             float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                                              \
00426                                                                                                                         \
00427             if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                                                       \
00428                 numSamples = maxSize;                                                                                   \
00429                                                                                                                         \
00430                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00431                     *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                                  \
00432                 }                                                                                                       \
00433             } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                                      \
00434                 numSamples = maxSize;                                                                                   \
00435                                                                                                                         \
00436                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00437                     *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples;                                  \
00438                 }                                                                                                       \
00439             } else {                                                                                                    \
00440                 numSamples = minSize;                                                                                   \
00441                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00442                     *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                                \
00443                 }                                                                                                       \
00444                                                                                                                         \
00445                 numSamples = diffSize;                                                                                  \
00446                 if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                                                        \
00447                     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                          \
00448                         *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL 0.f;                                        \
00449                     }                                                                                                   \
00450                 }                                                                                                       \
00451                 else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                                                   \
00452                     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                          \
00453                         *outputSamples++ = 0.f OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                                       \
00454                     }                                                                                                   \
00455                 }                                                                                                       \
00456             }                                                                                                           \
00457         }                                                                                                               \
00458                                                                                                                         \
00459         return newBuffer;                                                                                               \
00460     }                                                                                                                   \

00463     {                                                                                                                   \
00464         if(rightOperand.isNull())   return Buffer(leftOperand);                                                         \
00465         else                        return Buffer(leftOperand) OPSYMBOL rightOperand;                                   \
00466     }                                                                                                                   \

00489     {                                                                                                                   \
